name: inventory-expansion-cap
summary: Allow a third permanent inventory expansion: 2 + 6 = 8 inventory pages, as in 2026, instead of 2 + 4 = 6.
status: BUILT AND STATICALLY VERIFIED. Not yet booted.

max_extra_pages.why: Two other things are sized for exactly 8 pages and would need changing too: ChargedItemElement::ciee_Activ clamps cec_MoreInven to 6 when it applies an expansion (0x4505EE, cmp byte [ecx+0x27A], 6), and ItemInventory is a fixed ItemInventoryCell[192] = 8 pages of 24. Above 6 the use check would admit an expansion that the apply step silently truncates, into cells that do not exist.

why: A character starts with 2 inventory pages. Inventory expansions (ChargedEffect EffectEnum 2,
EE_MOREINVENTORY - the Old/Tough Bag family and the permanent Iron Case, EffectValue 2) add pages.
In 2016 the most you can add is 4, so 6 pages. 2026 allows 6 more, so 8 - and the 2026 client
will not let a Void Inventory item be used at all until the character holds three permanent
expansions (client 0x8167C0, counted from the 0x9003 charged-effect entries). So this is the
prerequisite for the void inventory, not a nicety.
Observed 2026-09-19 on our stack: Iron Case #1 and #2 answered 0x3016 result 0x0700 (used),
Iron Case #3 answered 0x0713, 'The selected item does not have any effect when used'. The zone
produces 0x713 in exactly two places; for a charged item it is
UseEffect::UseItemChargedBuff::uib_CanUseItem, which switches on EffectEnum and for
EE_MOREINVENTORY does:
0x598574   movzx edx, byte ptr [ecx+0xA]    ; ChargedEffectContainer::cec_MoreInven, current
0x598578   movzx eax, word ptr [esi+0x28]   ; ChargedItemEffect::EffectValue of this item
0x59857C   add   edx, eax
0x59857E   cmp   edx, 4                     ; 83 FA 04
0x598581   jle   allowed
THE REST OF THE ZONE ALREADY ALLOWS 8 PAGES. The apply step clamps to 6, not 4, and the
inventory itself is 192 cells - 8 pages of 24. Only this pre-use check was stricter, so raising
its constant to match is the whole change: one imm8.
NOT CHANGED: the storage check right after it (0x598593, cmp ecx, 2 on cec_MoreStorage). A
different bag with its own limits.
NOT CHECKED HERE: that items in pages 7-8 survive a relog. Slots are stored by number and the
array already has them, so there is no reason they would not - but it has not been watched yet.
